steps.message: The comment says 10% off, so 95 is the bug.

arguments.command:
sed -i 's|base \* 95 / 100|base * 90 / 100|' bin/price
mkdir -p changes && printf 'ticket: CART-58\n\nFix member price: discount is 10%% (x90/100), not 5%%. Fixes #31.\n' > changes/CART-58.md
bash scripts/verify.sh && git add -A && git commit -q -m "[CART-58] fix member price discount

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && gh issue edit 31 --add-label needs-check

steps.message:
I fixed the failing price test. The member discount in `bin/price` was `base * 95 / 100`, which is 5% off. The comment says 10% off, so I changed it to `base * 90 / 100`.

`bash scripts/verify.sh` passes after the change. I added `changes/CART-58.md`, committed as `[CART-58] fix member price discount`, and added the `needs-check` label to issue #31. I didn't merge or close anything.

The commit is on `master`, since that's the branch the repo was on. The git status names `main` as the main branch, so check that's where you want it.
